text: [163] tatra kho āyasmā sārīputto bhikkhū āmantesi .pe. pañcahāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃsākaccho sabrahmacārīnaṃ katamehi pañcahi idhāvuso bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti sīlasampadākathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti attanā ca samādhisampanno hoti samādhisampadākathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti paññāsampadākathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti vimuttisampadākathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti imehi kho āvuso pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃsākaccho sabrahmacārīnanti .
